title: Message/changes: updated field is JSON object not Id[] array
description: message.rs:735,750 — Message/changes response builds updated as serde_json::Map<String,Value> (serializes as JSON object {id: null, ...}) but RFC 8620 §5.2 requires updated: Id[] (JSON array). A JMAP client that follows the spec will fail to parse this response. The tests use .as_object() so they are also testing the wrong shape. Fix: change Map to Vec<Value>, push Value::String(id), emit as array. The null-patch concept is only valid in /set responses (RFC 8620 §5.3), not /changes.
